Video guides › Planning and Time

Start a timer from the calendar

▶ on a planned block starts its timer. A block later in the day moves to now, so the block shows what you are recording; it fills in as you work and grows past its end if you keep going.

Steps

The videos have music and no narration. These steps are their text version: select one to play from that moment.

When you’d use it

  • You planned a task for later but you're starting it now.
  • You want the calendar to show the time you really worked.
